name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohung Grafenhof
beschreibung: The farm and holiday apartment estate Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Grafenhof is situated in Ebbs, Tyrol. Categorised as an authentic gasthof, it combines welcoming holiday lodging with traditional dining options. The working farm offers guests genuine insights into Tyrolean agricultural life and daily traditions. The accommodation features multiple well-equipped holiday apartments of various sizes. Ebbs and its scenic environs provide an ideal setting for hiking excursions and cycling tours, complemented by straightforward connections to the local public transport network.
